message: @get has no option retyr, so Datastar ignores it. Did you mean retry?
@get has no option retyr, so Datastar ignores it. Did you mean retry?
postExpr writes the expression in parentheses, as one value, so JavaScript reads this comma as its comma operator and keeps only what follows it. The options go in the lambda after the call.
